title: DevSecOps Engineer

nodes.title: DevSecOps Fundamentals & Threat Modeling
nodes.subtitle: CIA triad, STRIDE threat modeling, shift-left security, security champions model
learning_objectives: Apply STRIDE threat modeling to identify architectural vulnerabilities early
Integrate security requirements into early product sprint planning
feynman_prompts: How does 'shifting left' reduce the exponential cost of fixing security bugs in production?
key_misconceptions: Treating security as a blocking gate at the very end of the release cycle

nodes.title: Secret Detection & Git Pre-Commit Hooks
nodes.subtitle: TruffleHog, Gitleaks, pre-commit hooks, secret revocation, entropy analysis
learning_objectives: Block accidental secret commits locally using automated pre-commit scanners
Execute enterprise Git repository scans for historical credential leaks
feynman_prompts: Why is deleting a leaked secret in a new commit insufficient to secure the credential?
key_misconceptions: Assuming private Git repositories are safe for storing hardcoded API credentials

nodes.title: Static Application Security Testing (SAST)
nodes.subtitle: Semgrep, SonarQube, abstract syntax tree (AST) rules, finding injection flaws
learning_objectives: Automate static source code analysis in CI pipelines using Semgrep/SonarQube
Differentiate true positives from noise and author custom linting rules
feynman_prompts: How does SAST analyze code without executing it, and what are its limitations regarding runtime context?
key_misconceptions: Relying exclusively on SAST tools without performing dynamic or interactive testing

nodes.title: Software Composition Analysis (SCA) & SBOM
nodes.subtitle: Snyk, Dependabot, CVE tracking, CVSS severity scoring, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)
learning_objectives: Scan open-source third-party dependencies for known CVE vulnerabilities
Generate and verify CycloneDX Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) in CI
feynman_prompts: What is a transitive dependency vulnerability and why is it dangerous?
key_misconceptions: Ignoring CVE alerts with medium severity that can be chained into remote code execution

nodes.title: Container Security & Vulnerability Scanning
nodes.subtitle: Trivy, Grype, Docker base image hardening, rootless containers, distroless images
learning_objectives: Scan Docker container images for OS-level and application CVEs using Trivy
Harden container images by adopting non-root users and minimal distroless bases
feynman_prompts: Why do distroless container images dramatically reduce an application's attack surface?
key_misconceptions: Using heavy full-OS base images (like ubuntu:latest) with package managers in production

nodes.title: Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST)
nodes.subtitle: OWASP ZAP, DAST automation, active vs passive scans, API vulnerability probing
learning_objectives: Automate dynamic web application vulnerability scanning against staging environments
Detect runtime vulnerabilities such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS)
feynman_prompts: How does DAST differ from SAST in detecting runtime authentication and session flaws?
key_misconceptions: Running destructive active DAST scans directly against live production customer databases

nodes.title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Security & Misconfigurations
nodes.subtitle: tfsec, Checkov, Kube-bench, CIS benchmarks, open security group detection
learning_objectives: Scan Terraform configurations and Kubernetes manifests for security anti-patterns
Enforce CIS benchmarks on cloud infrastructure before provisioning
feynman_prompts: Why is preventing cloud misconfigurations in Terraform easier than fixing them after cloud deployment?
key_misconceptions: Allowing public 0.0.0.0/0 ingress access to cloud database instances

nodes.title: Automated Security Quality Gates in CI/CD
nodes.subtitle: GitHub Actions security workflows, SARIF reports, policy-as-code with OPA/Conftest
learning_objectives: Implement automated build-breaking security gates for critical CVSS vulnerabilities
Centralize vulnerability reporting using standardized SARIF format in GitHub
feynman_prompts: How do automated security quality gates prevent known vulnerabilities from reaching production?
key_misconceptions: Allowing developers to bypass security pipeline failures without security team sign-off

nodes.title: Kubernetes Hardening, RBAC & Admission Controllers
nodes.subtitle: Kubernetes RBAC, ServiceAccounts, OPA Gatekeeper, Kyverno policy enforcement
learning_objectives: Enforce strict Kubernetes RBAC policies adhering to least privilege
Block non-compliant Pods using Kyverno or OPA Gatekeeper admission controllers
feynman_prompts: Why should default ServiceAccounts never be granted cluster-admin permissions?
key_misconceptions: Granting developer Pods hostPath volume mounts that allow root filesystem escape

nodes.title: Container Network Security & Micro-segmentation
nodes.subtitle: Kubernetes NetworkPolicies, Calico, mTLS service mesh with Istio/Linkerd
learning_objectives: Isolate sensitive database Pods using restrictive Kubernetes NetworkPolicies
Enforce mutual TLS (mTLS) encryption for all inter-service microservice communications
feynman_prompts: Why is default flat networking in Kubernetes a major lateral movement risk for attackers?
key_misconceptions: Assuming internal cluster traffic is safe without encrypting network communications via mTLS

nodes.title: Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)
nodes.subtitle: AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, IAM credential auditing, least-privilege cloud roles
learning_objectives: Audit cloud environments continuously for IAM privilege escalation vectors
Automate remediation of non-compliant cloud storage buckets and firewall rules
feynman_prompts: How do attackers exploit AWS IAM role privilege escalation to gain administrative control?
key_misconceptions: Generating long-lived static AWS access keys instead of using temporary IAM roles

nodes.title: Runtime Container Security & Threat Detection with Falco
nodes.subtitle: eBPF, Falco runtime rules, detecting shell spawns in containers, anomaly alerts
learning_objectives: Detect and alert on unexpected runtime container behavior (shell execution, privilege escalation)
Leverage eBPF kernel instrumentation for non-intrusive container monitoring
feynman_prompts: How does Falco detect unauthorized command executions inside running production containers?
key_misconceptions: Assuming that building secure container images eliminates the need for runtime monitoring

nodes.title: Zero Trust Architecture & Identity-Aware Proxies
nodes.subtitle: Zero Trust principles (Never Trust, Always Verify), BeyondCorp, Cloudflare Access
learning_objectives: Design corporate and developer network access adhering to Zero Trust principles
Replace legacy perimeter VPNs with Identity-Aware Proxies and contextual MFA
feynman_prompts: Why is the traditional castle-and-moat network perimeter model obsolete for cloud environments?
key_misconceptions: Trusting internal network connections purely based on IP subnet location

nodes.title: Software Supply Chain Security & Artifact Signing
nodes.subtitle: SLSA framework, Sigstore / Cosign, cryptographic image signing, artifact provenance
learning_objectives: Sign production container images cryptographically using Sigstore / Cosign
Verify image provenance and cryptographic signatures at Kubernetes admission time
feynman_prompts: Why is artifact signing essential to defend against software supply chain attacks (e.g., SolarWinds)?
key_misconceptions: Pulling mutable container image tags like :latest without verifying cryptographic digests

nodes.title: Compliance Automation: SOC2, ISO 27001 & HIPAA
nodes.subtitle: Automated compliance evidence collection, Drata/Vanta integration, continuous audit
learning_objectives: Automate infrastructure compliance evidence gathering for SOC 2 Type II audits
Map technical cloud controls directly to ISO 27001 and HIPAA security standards
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between a SOC 2 Type I report (point in time) and Type II (operating effectiveness)?
key_misconceptions: Treating compliance as an annual manual screenshot-gathering exercise rather than continuous code

nodes.title: Incident Response, Cloud Forensics & Postmortems
nodes.subtitle: Incident classification, compromised instance isolation, memory dumps, blameless postmortems
learning_objectives: Execute structured incident response playbooks for compromised cloud workloads
Perform forensic analysis on isolated virtual machines and author post-incident remediation plans
feynman_prompts: Why should a compromised cloud instance be isolated via security groups rather than immediately terminated?
key_misconceptions: Shutting down compromised servers immediately, destroying volatile memory evidence

nodes.title: Enterprise Vulnerability Management & Risk Prioritization
nodes.subtitle: Risk scoring (EPSS vs CVSS), SLA remediation timelines, exception workflows
learning_objectives: Prioritize security patches using Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS) and reachability
Establish automated SLA tracking and developer exception review workflows
feynman_prompts: Why does EPSS provide better remediation prioritization than relying solely on raw CVSS scores?
key_misconceptions: Forcing developers to drop critical features to patch low-exploitability theoretical vulnerabilities

nodes.title: DevSecOps Culture, Metrics & Program Maturation
nodes.subtitle: MTTR for vulnerabilities, security champion networks, developer security enablement
learning_objectives: Measure security program effectiveness using Mean Time to Remediate (MTTR)
Scale security culture across engineering teams through security champion programs
feynman_prompts: How do security champion networks scale security governance across large engineering organizations?
key_misconceptions: Measuring security success solely by number of blocked PRs, creating friction with product teams

description: Master DevSecOps Engineer with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
